entries.0e4ad9cb7c6624ed: A food ingredient manufacturer that produces and sells food emulsifiers and stabilizers, processed egg products, functional food materials and more.
entries.108dd847ce4ff40f: This segment manufactures and sells quality improvers such as emulsifiers. It sells to the dairy, beverage, confectionery, bakery and processed oil and fat industries, as well as to the cosmetics and toiletries industries. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 is ¥14,102 million.
entries.1af2b04d8033d7b1: This is a business segment not included in the reportable segments, engaged in cooking and food service businesses and other operations. Consolidated subsidiary Techno Marketing Co., Ltd. undertakes contracted operations such as security services and food and beverage services. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥151 million.
entries.3976c2ef98f8288f: Customers in the processed oils and fats industry
entries.4217c1d35c31a77e: This segment manufactures and sells food ingredients such as processed egg products, protein materials, instant food ingredients and processed agricultural products, as well as quality improvers and stabilizers. The consolidated subsidiaries Kaifeng Taiyo Kinmei Food Co., Ltd. and Kanavis (Tianjin) Food Co., Ltd. are responsible for manufacturing and sales. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 is ¥21,083 million.
entries.830fd543f698d70a: Customers for contracted operations and food and beverage services
entries.8508fdb56d37bef0: Customers in the Processed Agricultural Products Industry
entries.88236ef01cc35e2d: This segment manufactures and sells functional food ingredients such as catechins (green tea extract), theanine (a functional amino acid) and water-soluble dietary fiber, as well as mineral preparations and vitamin preparations. The consolidated subsidiaries Wuxi Taiyo Ryokuho Technology Co., Ltd. and Taiyo Kagaku India Private Limited are responsible for manufacturing and sales, and Taiyo Lab Co., Ltd. is responsible for sales. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 is ¥17,146 million.
entries.8a937f1bb332bd4a: Customers in the Prepared Food and Instant Noodle Industries
entries.b5254d246f3d41f2: Customers in the cosmetics and toiletries industry
entries.cbe49856f1d727d5: Headquartered in Yokkaichi, Mie Prefecture, the company and 10 subsidiaries and 1 associate form the group. Its main business is the manufacture and sale of food emulsifiers, stabilizers, various processed egg products, instant food ingredients, processed agricultural products, nutrition-function foods and cosmetic raw materials, and the consolidated headcount for the fiscal year ended March 2026 is 867.
